eps.ov: Arthur has been adventuring with Jasmine under the alias of Note, and they have a dangerous encounter.
Tessia has a mission to promote harmony between the races as an adventurer, and things aren't going smoothly.
Arthur, Elijah, and Lucas find themselves on a deserted island, so they try to find a way back home.
With quests at a standstill due to the recent mana beast issues, Arthur spends some time at home.
Arthur and Jasmine are recruited for a dungeon raid that ends up being more dangerous than it seemed.
In the lowest level of the dungeon, Arthur and his party have a horrifying encounter.
An unexpected ability helps Elijah save Arthur's life, as they try to find a way out of the dungeon.
Note faces an inquiry at the Guild, while Lucas schemes to avoid responsibility for his betrayal.
Having returned home with Elijah, Arthur prepares for school at the academy and bids Jasmine farewell.
Arthur seeks a gift to give Eleanor for her birthday, and has an interesting encounter as a result.
It's Eleanor's birthday, and Arthur has a special gift for his little sister.
Before enrolling in Xyrus Academy, Arthur faces the person responsible for his disastrous dungeon raid.
